name: Cognitive Science (BA)
totalCreditsNote: 120 cr per the 2026-27 catalog, at least 100 of them in Arts & Sciences and 80 letter-graded (the app doesn't check those two). Confirm with your advisor.
footnote: Major: at least 40 credits and 12 courses, all letter-graded C- or better. Admission requires good standing, COGST 1101 or COGST 2350, and two additional cognitive science courses, with C+ or better. The catalog does not clarify overlap among core, breadth, area and depth requirements; this layout uses separate placements. Confirm overlap and cross-listed department counting with an advisor. Major total checks include listed eligible courses anywhere in the plan; confirm that all counted courses are approved for the major. Graduate courses require advisor approval. Optional honors: apply at the end of junior year, major GPA at least 3.5 and faculty support; take 3 or 4 honors research credits in each senior semester, produce a thesis and complete an oral defense.

sections.title: Area Distribution
sections.note: Three courses from three different departments. Groups use the course-code department; confirm cross-listed courses with an advisor.

sections.title: Breadth: Three Concentrations
sections.note: One course from each of at least three of the five concentrations (Language Science, Evolution and Development, Computational Cognitive Science, Cognitive Neuroscience, Mind and Culture). The listed courses are samples; other specialized courses need advisor approval. A course counts in only one concentration.

sections.title: Depth Distribution and Electives

constraints.label: Independent study credits here
constraints.reason: At most 12 independent study credits count toward the major

sections.note: At least three depth courses and nine credits at the 3000/4000 level. Extra listed electives may go here to reach the major totals. Graduate courses need advisor approval and do not automatically replace the stated depth levels. Independent study is optional: at most 12 credits across the entire major, with 3 credits counting as one course, and a paper or report required. The app only enforces the research cap within this section and does not convert research credits to course equivalents.

sections.title: Physical Education
sections.note: Two PE classes plus the swim test, a university requirement. PE credits do not count toward the 120.
